generation_brief: Five original intense/stressful music auditions for the pre-Level-2 flush sequence. Use accelerating countdown urgency, insistent rhythm and mounting tension inspired by the feeling of a classic platformer low-air warning; compose new motifs, harmony and timbres. No copied Sonic melody, recording or arrangement. Auditions only, no runtime change.

choices.name: Pressure Clock
choices.description: Dry ticking, tight square-wave notes and a steadily accelerating bass pulse.

choices.name: Air Running Out
choices.description: Bright metallic synth alarms over a galloping bass; sharper and more arcade-like.

choices.name: Porcelain Panic
choices.description: Low industrial knocks, clipped chords and an increasingly frantic upper line.

choices.name: Last Breath
choices.description: Trembling string-like clusters and a heartbeat that grows into a rapid chase rhythm.

choices.name: Drain Spiral
choices.description: Bubbling electronic arpeggios climb above a pounding pulse and an unstable repeating figure.

provenance: Original sample-free composition and synthesis; no borrowed melody, recording, soundfonts, voice models or third-party samples. No third-party sample attribution obligations.
status: Auditions only; no runtime mapping or looping. Timing may be adapted after selection.
limitations: Signal QA only; perceived urgency, musical quality and game mix need listening review.
